title: Unscramble the pharma words
description: Put the letters in the correct order.

words.hint: A written order from a doctor to get a medicine.
A company that buys large quantities and sells to pharmacies.
A person or company between two others in a deal.
Swelling, redness and pain in a part of the body.
A substance made of two or more elements combined.
To make a substance in a laboratory.
A protein that speeds up chemical reactions in the body.
A legal right that stops others from making an invention.
A company that pays part of your medical costs.
